scope:
Test actual CYD open_stream and the configure-time SDK HTTP source overlay.

The host executes the unchanged extracted production function with explicit SDK
HTTP/clock/release-result seams, enabled and disabled, checking identical HTTP
outcomes. The separate SDK-source suite proves release/reallocation ownership.
The real CMake helper executes against build-local copied SDK input and a mock
component target; this does not replace the full target firmware build.
No installed SDK edits, application link, device or physical heap measurement.
